attempted_claim: For C general of genus 7 and L general of degree 14, B(2,L,5) inside SU_C(2,L) is nonempty of pure expected dimension rho_L = 3g-3-k(k-d+2g-2) = 3 and generically smooth (Petri map injective at a general point), with nonzero Porteous class in the expected codimension 15.
decisive_failure: The target stands unrefuted: every checkable count (Osserman delta=5, Clifford/Mercat, semistable boundary, Porteous codimension, chain admissibility) passes, but the gating generic-smoothness certificate is unclosed. The corrected split-point block table, extension census, formal Porteous polynomial, and chain scripts are banked as replayable artifacts, not Audit-level results. A future attack needs an explicit nonsplit fixed-fiber Petri-trace witness or the intersection ring of SU(2,L).
